input-field.name: enabled
input-field.label: Accept requests from Ecommerly
input-field.helpText: Turn this off to stop answering without unpairing. Pairing is kept, so turning it back on needs no new token.

input-field.name: ecommerlyBaseUrl
input-field.label: Ecommerly URL
input-field.helpText: Where this store sends its pairing request, for example https://app.ecommerly.com. Set this before running bin/console ecommerly:pair.
